anchor_text: <Dialogue speaker="SPEAKER_00" time="01:02:17">Thank you, Father. Y'all have a good night.</Dialogue>
<Dialogue speaker="SPEAKER_00" time="01:16:28">Well, I appreciate you guys a lot. And my husband and I listened to you guys on the way to work in the morning.</Dialogue>

<Dialogue speaker="SPEAKER_02" time="01:53:49">And when I say rewritten, I mean like stuff in [[Genesis]]. This is rewritten. Things are changed. Little stories are added and stuff. Two, for example, a bunch of things happen on Mount Gerizim, which happened to be in Samaritan territory, instead of, say, Mount Horeb.</Dialogue>
